reviews.comment: He cares about his students and doesn't want to overwhelm them. If anything, I felt a little under-challenged. Quizzes are take-home and pretty easy even though they're closed-note. One final project and participation during discussion days make it easy to get an A. Lectures and discussions were interesting but not as in-depth as I would have liked

He is a great professor who truly cares for his students and wants them to do well. I learned many topics from his class that I will be able to apply in my other classes and throughout my career. I really enjoyed the project-based class and we even had several days off of lecture to work on the projects! Overall, great prof!

Honestly one of the best profs I've had, bar none. He makes it pretty clear from the outset that he cares about his students, and he consistently does his best to keep students engaged, even over Zoom. The courses are structured very well, emphasizing group work and practical experience. I'm lucky to have had him!

reviews.comment: Dr. Patrick might just be my favorite professor ever. He loves teaching and loves his students. The material is tough but he makes it super manageable. Homework is done in groups, tests are essentially the easiest homework problems. He is very clear on how grades. He enables every student to get an A or B.
